BEFORE  HON'BLE SHRI JUSTICE RAJ MOHAN SINGH  ON THE 22 nd OF FEBRUARY, 2024  MISC. CRIMINAL CASE No. 17820 of 2017  BETWEEN:-
 KAMAL KUMAR ARORA S/O SHRI PURSHOTTAM DAS  ARORA, AGED ABOUT 63 YEARS, R/O 120/2, SUGAR  DEALER, MUKADAM GANJ, DISTRICT JABALPUR  (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI G.S. WADHWA - ADVOCATE)
 AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH SHRI  B.K.VERMA, FOOD INSPECTOR, DISTRICT, FLAYIN  SQUAD KATNI (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI V.P. TIWARI - GOVERNMENT ADVOCATE)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER This is a case having very pathetic state of affair.
opennyai_summary.final__arguments:
The categoric stand of the petitioner is that there was a violation of mandatory requirement in terms of Section 13(2) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, inasmuch as that the petitioner was never given option for re-testing of the second sample before the Central Laboratory at Mysore.
Learned Government Advocate for the respondent-State is directed to seek instructions as to whether compliance has been made or not?
opennyai_summary.final__ANALYSIS:
During the intervening period, the case was also dismissed for non-prosecution on 10.08.2023, but the same was restored vide order dated 30.01.2024.
The inaction on behalf of the State has unnecessarily consumed valuable time of the Court for nothing.
The stand of the petitioner in respect of non compliance of provision of Section 13(2) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act has not been denied till date and the same amounts to admission.
Learned counsel for the respondent/State has been involved only in seeking unnecessary adjournments from time to time and has not taken any steps to produce the relevant material to show that the compliance of Section 13(2) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, was ever made.
opennyai_summary.final__decision:
The compliance of Section 13(2) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act was repaired to be mandatorily done and non-compliance of the same would result in discarding the prosecution story against the petitioner.
As a result of the aforesaid, this petition is accepted.
The impugned prosecution against the petitioner is quashed.
